set.body: Continue the parity-gated campaign after exact ILP and mutable deboxing. Start with demonstrated rank-2 reduction locality and contiguous primitive losses, preserve NaN/signed-zero/overflow/fixed-pairwise contracts, then remeasure and select the next matrix bottleneck. Acceptance: focused before/after JMH plus GC where relevant; full semantic signatures pass; JVM and Scala.js laws pass; no public API or numerical-contract weakening; record any irreducible loss honestly.
set.title: Eliminate residual public operation-matrix bottlenecks
